managed_channels.info: One plugin directory that manages Alipay, WeChat, and QQ epay upstream accounts.

notes: Initialize the universal epay plugin config table and log table.
Store managed upstream merchant id, gateway url, merchant key, and mode in the shared account fields.
This plugin provides one managed account model for Alipay, WeChat, and QQ epay upstream gateways.
Order creation, callback settlement, and basic query/refund entrypoints are handled inside Webman.
checklist: Verify there is no pending cleanup plan before upgrade.
Confirm admin_channel still keeps universal_epay in managed-plugin mode after upgrade.

changelog.summary: First standalone universal epay plugin directory release.
notes: Use one plugin directory to manage Alipay, WeChat, and QQ epay channels.
Shared account fields map to gateway url, merchant id, merchant key, and interface mode.
Restore the plugin directory and pay_plugin_universal_epay_* tables before rollback.
Business order, merchant, fund, and settlement data remain outside plugin cleanup scope.
Safe cleanup removes only runtime files and the plugin-owned config table.
Purge removes the package directory and plugin log table, then attempts managed-channel cleanup.
